contradictions.claim: Brighton Fringe clearly communicates ticketing procedures and responsibilities to venue managers.
contradictions.reality: Ben Carter was not informed of ticketing policy changes or fee responsibilities. Fringe staff admitted confusion and inconsistent enforcement.

contradictions.claim: Fringe respects artist and venue control over event visibility and communications.
contradictions.reality: Brighton Fringe removed events from the site without contactable attendee records due to unticketed status, undermining venues’ communication plans.
laws_breached: Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008

contradictions.claim: Brighton Fringe enabled venues and producers to promote their shows with clarity and confidence.
contradictions.reality: Due to ongoing safeguarding concerns and instability, Ben Carter was unable to print a fully designed 90-page Half a Camel brochure, losing weeks of labour.

timeline.event: Brighton Fringe Box Office expresses confusion about ticketing procedures and customer contact.
Ticketing dispute emerges as Ben is informed of artist fee obligations not included in his agreement.
Brighton Fringe confirms removal of an unticketed show from the website; no way to notify attendees.
Ben Carter completes unprinted Half a Camel brochure; unable to release it due to safeguarding instability.
